verdict.rationale: Signifyd is a fraud-protection SaaS with an API, SDKs and a device-profiling script, so a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question for it. The evidence pack never mentions any telemetry opt-out, tracking controls or privacy settings for users. The sensitive-data rejection layer and the device-profiling docs describe data handling and fraud signal collection, not a way to opt out of tracking.
